events.did: stood in his office as the world shuddered and stabilized instead of disappearing
events.quote_anchor: It shuddered briefly, like a camera losing focus, but when it stabilized a moment later, he was still standing in his office

events.did: walked toward the door and saw the room flicker to reveal shattered glass, Helena's blood and ash
events.quote_anchor: revealing momentary glimpses of an altered room—a shattered glass, Helena’s blood, and ash, the furniture askew—before regaining its composure.

events.did: realized he was inside Serena's sphere of influence, in a dream of his and her own making
events.quote_anchor: That despite appearances, he was indeed inside Serena’s sphere of influence. A dream of his—and her—own making.

events.did: limped into the hall and found Noah lying dead
events.quote_anchor: There his good mood guttered when he found Noah lying dead.

events.did: found several agents blindly wandering under Serena's fog and could not wrest them back
events.quote_anchor: He found several agents blindly wandering, rendered useless by Serena’s fog. He tried to wrest them back, will them into doing as he said, to no effect.

events.did: freed a tablet from an agent's hand, ordered Control to lock the building down, and got no answer
events.quote_anchor: He freed a tablet from an agent’s hand and ordered Control to lock the building down. Was annoyed but unsurprised when no one answered.

events.did: scanned the cameras with the tablet and located Sydney and Serena
events.quote_anchor: Using the device to scan the cameras, he located Sydney and Serena, and he was about to head toward them

events.did: saw a red pickup drive through the gates on a motion-activated camera, changed plans, drew a knife from the agent's belt and went to find Eli
events.quote_anchor: One of the external, motion-activated cameras showed a red pickup driving through the gates. Change of plans, thought Gabriel.

relations.did: Gabriel was inside Serena's sphere of influence, in a dream of their own making
relations.quote_anchor: he was indeed inside Serena’s sphere of influence. A dream of his—and her—own making.

relations.did: Gabriel found Noah's dead body in the hall, excised from his dream except in fragments when pain shot up his leg
relations.quote_anchor: It lay there in reality, but had been neatly excised from his dream, the body only visible in fragments, when the pain shot up his injured leg.

relations.did: Gabriel ordered Control to lock the building down and no one answered him
relations.quote_anchor: Was annoyed but unsurprised when no one answered.

relations.did: Gabriel drew a knife and went to find Eli
relations.quote_anchor: He drew a knife from the agent’s belt and went to find Eli.

numbers.did: the number of agents Gabriel found wandering: several
numbers.quote_anchor: He found several agents blindly wandering, rendered useless by Serena’s fog.

numbers.did: the number of cameras that showed the red pickup: One
numbers.quote_anchor: One of the external, motion-activated cameras showed a red pickup driving through the gates.

numbers.did: how often it flickered as he moved: every step
numbers.quote_anchor: With every step, the room around him flickered, revealing momentary glimpses of an altered room
